title: Program traced to Dachau: vanished children in gas chambers

tellings.quote: I think it started at Dhaka. I think it started in the camps

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer who says he has met aliens, believes a secret programme began in the Nazi camps, at Dachau, in the 1940s. As the story is framed, the programme is tied to children who vanished in the gas chambers. Strieber tells Michels "I think it started at Dachau. I think it started in the camps," and names no source. If true, the programme he describes has its roots in Nazi atrocities.
